## AlertDialog

`import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogMedia, AlertDialogOverlay, AlertDialogPortal, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

For a confirmation the operator cannot dismiss by clicking outside it: `Dialog` closes on an outside click, this does not. Reach for it when the action is destructive or hard to undo; everything else wants `Dialog`.

## HoverCard

`import { HoverCard, HoverCardContent, HoverCardTrigger } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A preview on hover or focus, for a fact worth a glance without leaving the page: a person's details behind their name, a linked record's summary. Reach for `Tooltip` instead when the content is a single short label.

Also takes: bits-ui `HoverCard.Root` props.

### `HoverCardContent`

The floating card. A ring rather than a border, and `rounded-2xl` rather than shadcn's `rounded-md`: 6px was the smallest radius in a system whose cards are 24px.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `portalProps` | `HoverCardPrimitive.PortalProps` |  |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `HoverCard.Content` props.

Also takes: bits-ui `HoverCard.Trigger` props.

## Popover

`import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A positioned panel with no semantics of its own; whatever goes in it brings its meaning. Reach for it when the content is not a list of commands: a filter, a form, a preview, a feed. Commands want `DropdownMenu`.

Also takes: bits-ui `Popover.Root` props.

### `PopoverContent`

The floating panel. It is not a `flex flex-col gap-4` like the reference's settings panel: most popovers are menus, filters or list panels that pass `p-0` and own their layout, and `p-0` cancels padding but not a gap. Add `flex flex-col gap-4` at the call site for the form case.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `matchTriggerWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | The panel takes the trigger's exact width instead of its own `w-72`, and drops the padding: the shape a Select-like popover wants, where the content inside owns its own padding. |
| `portalProps` | `PopoverPrimitive.PortalProps` |  |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `Popover.Content` props.

### `PopoverTrigger`

Also takes: bits-ui `Popover.Trigger` props.

## Tooltip

`import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Also takes: bits-ui `Tooltip.Root` props.

### `TooltipContent`

The panel sits on `bg-popover` with the ring and shadow every floating panel here carries, not the inverted `bg-foreground text-background` tooltip idiom. The inversion looks deliberate in light mode and renders a page-bright block over a dark UI in dark mode. The arrow follows the surface and carries no ring of its own.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `portalProps` | `TooltipPrimitive.PortalProps` |  |  |

Also takes: bits-ui `Tooltip.Content` props.
